units.source_text: 太阳高升时，格子窗都开了，右近随侍在浮舟身边。

en.t: When the sun had risen high, all the lattice windows were opened, and Ukon attended at Ukifune's side.

units.source_text: 正厅的帘子一律挂下，贴上“禁忌”的字条。

en.t: The blinds of the main hall were all lowered, and slips marked "ritual abstinence" were pasted up.

units.source_text: 如果常陆守夫人亲自来接，准备骗她说“小姐昨夜梦见不祥”，请她不要会面。

en.t: If the wife of the Governor of Hitachi came in person to fetch her, they were prepared to deceive her by saying, "The young lady had an ominous dream last night," and ask her not to meet anyone.

units.source_text: 送进来的盥洗水同平日一样，只有一份。

en.t: The washing water brought in was the same as usual, with only one portion.

units.source_text: 匂亲王觉得不周全，对浮舟说：“你先洗吧。”

en.t: Prince Niou thought this was inconsiderate and said to Ukifune, "You wash first."

units.source_text: 浮舟看惯了斯文一脉的薰大将，如今看到了片刻不见她便焦灼欲死的匂亲王，想起所谓多情种者，大约就是这样的人了。

en.t: Ukifune was used to the refined and gentle Captain Kaoru, and now, seeing Prince Niou so frantic that he seemed ready to die if he lost sight of her for even a moment, she thought that this must be what people meant by a passionate lover.

units.source_text: 又念此身命运何等乖戾，如果此事宣泄出去，不知外人将如何讥评。

en.t: She also thought how perverse her fate was, and wondered how outsiders would mock and judge her if this affair became known.

units.source_text: 最担心的是恐被姐姐闻知。

en.t: What worried her most was the fear that her elder sister might hear of it.

units.source_text: 但匂亲王并未知道她是何人，他频频探问：“我屡次问你，你总不肯说，教人好气啊！

en.t: But Prince Niou still did not know who she was, and he questioned her again and again: "I have asked you so many times, yet you never will tell me. It is truly maddening!

units.source_text: 还望你把姓名告诉我吧。
无论你出身何等微贱，我总越来越疼爱你。”

en.t: No matter how humble your birth may be, I only grow more and more fond of you."
But Ukifune absolutely refused to tell him.

units.source_text: 关于别的事情，她都和蔼可亲地回答，态度十分柔顺。

en.t: About other matters, she answered kindly and amiably, and her manner was very gentle and compliant.

units.source_text: 因此匂亲王无限地怜爱她。

en.t: For that reason, Prince Niou cherished her without limit.
